meta.name: deck-ljg-present
meta.description: 把 outline 1:1 铸成色块大字宣言 deck, 原文不动只做美化。三档主题 black / red / yellow

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把大纲一键转成大字宣言风格幻灯片
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速把文字大纲变成视觉冲击力强的演示文稿。
copy.tagline_en: Turn outlines into bold statement decks with one click
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly turn text outlines into visually impactful presentations.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把你的 outline 或 markdown 内容直接转成色块大字宣言风格的幻灯片，不修改原文，只调整分页和视觉样式，输出一个可直接运行的 HTML 文件。提供黑、红、黄三种主题色。
howto.when: 当你提供演讲提纲、列表或 markdown 文本，并指示 Claude 将其生成宣言式幻灯片时触发。你也可以指定主题色，如“用红色主题”。

say.text: 把我的演讲提纲转成宣言式幻灯片，用红色主题。
say.note: Claude 会逐页渲染为红底白字。

say.text: 把这段markdown变成黑底白字的大字deck。
say.note: 输出黑色主题宣言幻灯片。

say.text: 用黄色主题，强调批判语气，把下面内容做成宣言页：
say.note: 黄色主题用于反讽或警觉内容。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude will convert your outline or markdown content directly into a blocky big-font manifesto-style slide deck without rewriting the original text—only adjusting pagination and visual styling, outputting a self-contained HTML file. Three themes: black, red, yellow.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide an outline, list, or markdown text and ask Claude to turn it into a manifesto-style slide deck. You can also specify a theme color, e.g., 'use red theme'.

say_en.text: Turn my speech outline into a manifesto deck using red theme.
say_en.note: Claude renders each page with red background and white text.

say_en.text: Make this markdown into a black-on-white big-font deck.
say_en.note: Outputs a black theme manifesto slide.

say_en.text: Use yellow theme with critical tone, turn the following into manifesto pages:
say_en.note: Yellow theme for sarcasm or caution.
